summary: Meat Boy entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Super Meat Boy
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release, with soundtrack/storefront/version state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with documented soundtrack/storefront state

primary.version: Current PC release with soundtrack/version noted
primary.why: The PC version is the strongest precision-platforming capture route and includes PC-specific character/content context depending on storefront. Later console ports may use alternate music because of soundtrack licensing, so version and soundtrack state should be logged.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/build, soundtrack version, controller, resolution, save/completion state, warp zones, dark world, bandages, character unlocks, and whether console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting those version differences.
secondary.why: PC is the best capture route, but ports can differ in music and extras.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record soundtrack version, character unlocks, completion state, and controller/latency setup.
